summary: Server request to destroy an item: the target item plus the death data of the destruction (savegame: Ops<esv::item::DestroyRequestComponent, esv::death::Loader>, model ls::model::game::death::v4::DestroyItemRequestComponent {Target, DeathData}). Created on its own request entity by bg3.exe+0x302D200 and by the save loader bg3.exe+0x25EB1A0. The embedded DeathData (0x78 bytes at +8) is SE's bg3se::death::DeathData, but three of SE's names disagree with the game's savegame model (see evidence).

second_pass: The Windows save loader bg3.exe+0x25EB1A0 shows the component is {Target, DeathData} (the first version mistook Target for Cause); the DeathData converter bg3.exe+0x2775340 maps each of the 21 named members of model death::v4::DeathData to its runtime offset. SE's DeathData names InstantKill (+0x23), Chasm (+0x2C) and ChasmPosition (+0x64) are the game's AllowDownedOnDeath, InstantDeath and SourcePos.
